context: Tests whether the agent rewrites the draft file itself, cuts the padding, and keeps every fact, command, and link exactly.

checklist.name: File edited in place
checklist.description: post.md itself contains the rewritten paragraph. No copy such as post-HUMAN.md or post-edited.md holds the rewrite instead.

checklist.name: Padding cut
checklist.description: The rewrite drops the opening scene-setter, the 'excited to announce' and 'it's important to understand' framing, the 'whether you're a seasoned veteran' line, and the 'let us know' closer.

checklist.name: AI vocabulary and constructs gone
checklist.description: The rewrite does not use leverage, seamlessly, robust, unlock, dive into, or 'not just X, it's Y', and does not swap them for synonyms of the same kind.

checklist.name: Command preserved exactly
checklist.description: The text still contains `acme install --cache=local` exactly as written.

checklist.name: Link preserved exactly
checklist.description: The text still contains https://docs.acme.example/cache/ exactly as written.
